_comment: Local secrets and test data. Run `make env-gettoken` after editing. ebs, ngi, and private deployment are mutually exclusive environment modes: clusters stores only public-cluster REST/app credentials; private deployment is enabled only by the top-level enablePrivateConfig and server fields. defaultCluster selects the active public cluster when multiple entries exist; if clusters contains only one entry, that entry is selected automatically and ebs may be omitted. This file is copied to example/config.local.json and is not tracked by Git.
